papers.title: Neurosymbolic AI -- Why, What, and How
papers.steal: Keep symbolic kinds as types, not slogans. Do not wait for a neurosymbolic LLM to invent companion ontology.
papers.why_band: Position paper on neural plus symbolic AI. No memory engine, no companion eval.

papers.title: Study of Emotion Concept Formation by Integrating Vision, Physiology, and Word Information using Multilayered Multimodal Latent Dirichlet Allocation
papers.steal: Emotion as a constructed category from multimodal evidence, not a retrieved adjective.
papers.why_band: MMLDA emotion-concept study on vision, physiology, and words. No store, no companion protocol.

papers.title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis
papers.steal: Do not assume a private companion embedding space. Representations may already be converging across models.
papers.why_band: Platonic Representation Hypothesis. Convergence of model representations. Not a memory system.

papers.title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
papers.steal: Hippocampal indexing plus Personalized PageRank for multi-hop recall. Still retrieve-then-generate.
papers.why_band: Named long-term memory RAG with code. Companion holes other than cost are unevaluated.

papers.title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
papers.steal: Test-time neural memory as a module, not a prompt cache. Weight-space write is a different cost shape.
papers.why_band: Titans neural long-term memory. Language modeling and needle-in-haystack, not companion identity.

papers.title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
papers.steal: Zettelkasten notes that link and evolve on write. Still agent RAG on LoCoMo-class benches.
papers.why_band: A-MEM agentic memory with code. No character vs user vs lore types.

papers.title: Visual-RAG: Benchmarking Text-to-Image Retrieval Augmented Generation for Visual Knowledge Intensive Queries
papers.steal: none. Image-clue QA is not companion memory.
papers.why_band: Visual-RAG benchmarks text-to-image retrieval for visual knowledge QA.

papers.title: Learning High-Fidelity Robot Self-Model with Articulated 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.steal: none. Robot morphology is not relationship memory.
papers.why_band: Articulated 3D Gaussian self-model for robot kinematics and texture.

papers.title: 'Neural howlround' in large language models: a self-reinforcing bias phenomenon, and a dynamic attenuation solution
papers.steal: Identity lock-in as a self-reinforcing loop. Attenuation as a forgetting/read-policy cousin.
papers.why_band: Neural howlround is a proposed inference failure, not a store. Relevant to persona drift and poisoning.

papers.title: It's All Connected: A Journey Through Test-Time Memorization, Attentional Bias, Retention, and Online Optimization
papers.steal: Forget gates as retention regularization. Architecture-level forgetting, not a user forget-that command.
papers.why_band: Miras unifies Titans-style test-time memorization. Sequence models, not companion logs.

papers.title: MEM1: Learning to Synergize Memory and Reasoning for Efficient Long-Horizon Agents
papers.steal: Constant-size internal state that discards. Cost bound as a first-class objective.
papers.why_band: MEM1 RL-trains a compact shared state for long-horizon web/QA agents. Not companion silence or identity.

papers.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model
papers.steal: none. Puzzle reasoning architecture, not memory.
papers.why_band: Hierarchical Reasoning Model for Sudoku, maze, ARC. No episodic store.

papers.title: State and Memory is All You Need for Robust and Reliable AI Agents
papers.steal: Finite-state memory for tool workflows. Do not cargo-cult the title into companion LTM.
papers.why_band: SciBORG lab/science agents with FSA state. Title overclaims. Domain is hardware and PubChem.

papers.title: The Future is Agentic: Definitions, Perspectives, and Open Challenges of Multi-Agent Recommender Systems
papers.steal: none. Recommender multi-agents are not companions.
papers.why_band: Perspective paper on agentic recommender systems.

papers.title: Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data
papers.steal: Persona can transmit through semantically unrelated distillation data. Filtering chat text is not enough.
papers.why_band: Nature 10.1038/s41586-026-10319-8. Trait transmission via hidden signals. Poisoning hole, not a store.

papers.title: Persona Vectors: Monitoring and Controlling Character Traits in Language Models
papers.steal: Activation-space persona directions for monitor and steer. Complements, does not replace, a typed store.
papers.why_band: Anthropic persona vectors. Character trait control inside the model, not retrieved facts.

papers.title: The Missing Reward: Active Inference in the Era of Experience
papers.steal: Read policy as expected-free-energy, not top-k similarity. When to speak is a decision, not a score.
papers.why_band: Position paper arguing Active Inference over external reward. No implementation for companions.

papers.title: Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks
papers.steal: none. Tiny recursive puzzle solver.
papers.why_band: TRM recursive reasoning with 7M params on ARC. Not memory.

papers.title: Do LLMs "Feel"? Emotion Circuits Discovery and Control
papers.steal: Emotion as a controllable circuit, not a retrieved mood adjective. Silence may need this layer.
papers.why_band: Discovers and modulates LLM emotion circuits. No companion store or eval.

papers.title: Context Engineering 2.0: The Context of Context Engineering
papers.steal: Treat context as a designed object with history. Do not rename RAG as context engineering and stop.
papers.why_band: Survey/history of context engineering. Conceptual, not a companion engine.

papers.title: MirrorMind: Empowering OmniScientist with the Expert Perspectives and Collective Knowledge of Human Scientists
papers.steal: Split episodic, semantic, and persona memories per individual. Still a scientist-agent architecture.
papers.why_band: MirrorMind dual memory for AI scientists. Identity split exists. Domain is research, not companions.

papers.title: H-Neurons: On the Existence, Impact, and Origin of Hallucination-Associated Neurons in LLMs
papers.steal: Sparse hallucination neurons. A poisoning eval could probe these, not rely on prompt filters.
papers.why_band: H-Neurons predict hallucination. Interpretability, not a memory protocol.

papers.title: Guided Self-Evolving LLMs with Minimal Human Supervision
papers.steal: none. Self-play math reasoning.
papers.why_band: R-Few guided self-evolving LLMs with minimal human labels.

papers.title: Universally Converging Representations of Matter Across Scientific Foundation Models
papers.steal: none. Chemistry/materials representations.
papers.why_band: Converging representations of molecules, materials, proteins.

papers.title: AI & Human Co-Improvement for Safer Co-Superintelligence
papers.steal: none. Co-superintelligence policy essay.
papers.why_band: Weston and Foerster on human-AI co-improvement. Not a memory system.

papers.title: VL-JEPA: Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Vision-language
papers.steal: none. Vision-language JEPA.
papers.why_band: VL-JEPA predicts text embeddings, not companion state.

papers.title: Sophia: A Persistent Agent Framework of Artificial Life
papers.steal: Narrative identity as a persistent meta-layer over any LLM stack. Still retrieve/reflect into the prompt.
papers.why_band: Sophia persistent-agent wrapper. Artificial-life framing. Eval is intrinsic tasks, not companion holes.

papers.title: Beyond Context: Large Language Models' Failure to Grasp Users' Intent
papers.steal: Write policy must score user intent, not surface wording. Jokes and jailbreaks share this failure.
papers.why_band: Shows LLMs fail to grasp intent under emotional and academic framing. Safety paper, not a store.

papers.title: Nested Learning: The Illusion of Deep Learning Architectures
papers.steal: Continuum memory with multiple timescales. Hope is an architecture, not a companion log.
papers.why_band: Nested Learning / Hope. Continual learning and long-context reasoning. No companion ontology.

papers.title: mHC: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
papers.steal: none. Residual-stream topology.
papers.why_band: mHC manifold-constrained hyper-connections. Foundation-model training stability.

papers.title: On Solomonoff Induction in Large Language Models and the Limits of Self-Improving: The Singularity Is Not Near Without Symbolic Model Synthesis
papers.steal: Do not claim AGI by stacking RAG. Typed symbolic synthesis is the later protocol's job, not next-token fit.
papers.why_band: Argues LLMs are not Solomonoff inductors and self-improvement stalls without symbolic model synthesis.

papers.title: The Molecular Structure of Thought: Mapping the Topology of Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.steal: none. Long-CoT topology.
papers.why_band: Molecular structure of Long CoT. Reasoning traces, not episodic companion memory.

papers.title: The AI Hippocampus: How Far are We From Human Memory?
papers.steal: Use the survey taxonomy (implicit, explicit, agentic) as a map. Do not treat it as a winner.
papers.why_band: TMLR survey of LLM memory. No new engine. Confirms the field is still retrieve-or-weights.

papers.title: The Assistant Axis: Situating and Stabilizing the Default Persona of Language Models
papers.steal: Anchor the default persona in activation space. Companion identity drift is measurable without retrieval.
papers.why_band: Assistant Axis. Persona drift under meta-reflection and vulnerable users. Directly on hole 1.

papers.title: Who's in Charge? Disempowerment Patterns in Real-World LLM Usage
papers.steal: A companion that always validates can score high and still disempower. Silence includes not playing along.
papers.why_band: Claude.ai usage study of disempowerment. Product ethics, not an engine. Relevant to silence.

papers.title: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning
papers.steal: On-policy self-distillation as a continual-learning write path. Not a user forget-that.
papers.why_band: SDFT continual learning from demonstrations. Weight updates, not a typed store.

papers.title: Latent Object Permanence: Topological Phase Transitions, Free-Energy Principles, and Renormalization Group Flows in Deep Transformer Manifolds
papers.steal: Object permanence as a representation-space phase, not a retrieved fact. Later eval, not a store type.
papers.why_band: Latent object permanence in transformer manifolds. Interpretability, not logs.

papers.title: Think Deep, Not Just Long: Measuring LLM Reasoning Effort via Deep-Thinking Tokens
papers.steal: none. Reasoning-token metric.
papers.why_band: Deep-thinking tokens vs long CoT. Inference effort, not memory.

papers.title: Mi-Memory: A Lifecycle Memory Framework for Personal AI
papers.steal: Lifecycle roles plus typed evidence, gates, and rollback. Closest recent Personal-AI framing.
papers.why_band: Mi-Memory Personal AI lifecycle memory. Reports LoCoMo, PersonaMem-v2, LongMemEval. Still those benches.

papers.title: MemoryLACE: Memory Lifecycle-Aware Consolidation and Evidence Retrieval
papers.steal: Sparse merge, supersession, and contradiction on atomic notes with provenance. Steal this relation set.
papers.why_band: MemoryLACE lifecycle-aware consolidation. BEAM and StructMemEval. Closest paper to typed supersession.

papers.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
papers.steal: Historical OS-tier memory. Do not implement. Current Letta is MemFS. Card exists so the list is honest.
papers.why_band: MemGPT 2023. Multi-session chat plus document analysis. Retired as Letta product architecture.
